Zygodactyl_Grasping_Talons.description: Equipped with sharp, curved claws that allow for both efficient climbing and formidable grappling, the Zygodactyl Grasping Talons enhance agility and strength, enabling their wielder to traverse treacherous heights with ease and seize foes with bone-crushing grip.

Palmate_Webbed_Paddling_Feet.description: Equipped with avian-inspired webbing that stretches from toe to toe, these paddle-like feet not only enhance the wearer's swimming speed but also grant them the ability to perform a swift Swim Dash, allowing them to glide through water with unparalleled agility.

Gargantuan_Cassowary_Striking_Legs.description: Enormous and terrifying, the Gargantuan Cassowary's legs are a deadly amalgamation of brute strength and ferocity, their powerful strides capable of shattering bones and toppling foes with each earth-shaking step, while the creature's savage kicks can deliver devastating Knockdowns and Sunder attacks that leave enemies reeling and broken.

Elongated_Wading_Stilts.description: Borrowing the elongated, heron-like stilts of an ancient swamp guardian, this component grants the user an increased reach and stealth, allowing them to traverse treacherous swampland with ease and ignore the usual penalties of such terrain.

Feathered_Snowshoe_Tarsi.description: Equipped with feathered snowshoe-like tarsi, this avian component grants unparalleled mobility across snowy terrains, enhancing the wearer's constitution and allowing them to traverse deep snow with ease, as if the ground held no resistance.

Lobate_Diving_Toes.description: Equipped with elongated, lobed toes reminiscent of a grebe’s, this avian-inspired limb modification grants enhanced swimming and walking speed, coupled with increased agility, allowing for swift underwater dashes and graceful land movements.

Raptorial_Crushing_Talons.description: Equipped with razor-sharp talons that can shred through flesh and bone with terrifying ease, these avian limbs are the perfect blend of brute strength and agility, allowing their wielder to strike with the force of an eagle diving from the sky, its talons capable of both grappling foes and inflicting grievous wounds.

Asymmetrical_Climbing_Paws.description: Equipped with a pair of sleek, avian-inspired paws, this unique appendage features elongated, curved claws on one side and soft, adhesive pads on the other, granting unparalleled climbing prowess while subtly enhancing dexterity and imposing a slight burden on agility.

Vestigial_Burrowing_Nubs.description: These tiny, vestigial appendages, remnants of a once-powerful burrowing ability, now serve as subtle aids for stealth, their small, clawed tips allowing the creature to grip and maneuver through tight spaces, though they hinder its overall agility and speed.

Spurred_Defensive_Calcar.description: Equipped with razor-sharp calcar spurs, this avian component enhances the agility and strength of its bearer, enabling swift, deadly strikes that can cause grievous bleeding wounds, a trait particularly favored among pheasant-like predators for their ferocious combat prowess.
